onboarding.title: Your investor profile
onboarding.saveError: We couldn't save your answers. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.resumed: Welcome back — we kept your earlier answers.

income_stability.title: How steady is your monthly income?

options.very_stable: Very steady — a fixed salary or reliable business income
options.somewhat_stable: Mostly steady, with some ups and downs
options.unstable: Irregular — it changes a lot month to month

investment_horizon.title: When do you think you will need this money back?

loss_tolerance.title: If your investment dropped 15% in one month, what would you do?

options.buy_more: Buy more while the price is low

market_experience.title: Have you invested in shares before?

options.some: A little, or through a mutual fund
options.none: No, this is my first time

investment_goal.title: What do you want this money to do?

options.growth: Grow as much as possible, even with big swings
options.preservation: Keep its value safe from inflation

emergency_savings.title: If you lost your income, how long could your savings cover your expenses?

caps.short_horizon: Because you need this money back within a year, we have kept your profile Conservative. Share prices can fall sharply in the short term, and there may not be time to recover.
caps.sells_on_loss: Because you said you would sell if your investment dropped, we have kept your profile no higher than Moderate. Bigger swings could push you to sell at a loss.
caps.low_emergency_savings: Because your savings would cover less than 3 months of expenses, we have kept your profile no higher than Moderate. Your safety cushion comes before higher-risk investing.

onboarding.loadError: We couldn't load your saved answers. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.draftSaveError: We couldn't save your progress just now. Your answers are still here, and we'll save them again with your next answer.
onboarding.cancelRetake: Cancel and keep my current profile

description.conservative: Protecting your money comes first. You prefer slow, steady gains over risky bets, so InvestIQ will lean towards stable, lower-volatility companies.
description.moderate: You want growth without losing sleep. InvestIQ will balance steady dividend payers with some higher-growth companies.
description.aggressive: You are comfortable with big ups and downs in exchange for higher long-term growth. InvestIQ will include more high-growth, higher-volatility companies.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is your investing snapshot.
dashboard.portfolioEmptyBody: Tell us how much you want to invest. InvestIQ will suggest a spread across PSX companies, with every charge and tax shown.

stocks.title: PSX companies
stocks.subtitle: Companies in the KSE-100 index. Search by ticker, company name or sector.
stocks.noResults: No PSX companies match “{{query}}”. Try a ticker (SYS), a name (Meezan) or a sector (Cement).
stocks.loadError: We couldn't load the company list.

stockDetail.notFound: {{ticker}} is not one of the KSE-100 stocks tracked by InvestIQ.
stockDetail.unavailable: Market data is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
stockDetail.insufficientHistory: Insufficient data: this stock has too little trading history for a reliable chart or prediction.
stockDetail.delayNote: Prices are end-of-day and can be a day or two behind PSX.

prediction.title: AI forecast
prediction.subtitle: From an LSTM price model, with a Random Forest buy/sell/hold signal as a second opinion. Both were trained on liquid KSE-100 stocks and tested on months they never saw.

forecast.up: The model forecasts a {{pct}} rise for the next trading day.
forecast.down: The model forecasts a {{pct}} fall for the next trading day.
forecast.flat: The model forecasts almost no change for the next trading day.

prediction.confidenceHelp: How often forecasts this certain got the direction (up or down) right on past data the model did not train on. It is not a guarantee.
prediction.lowConfidenceIntro: Treat this as a weak signal, not advice:

reason.below_threshold: The chance the direction is right is below {{threshold}}%.
reason.models_disagree: The price forecast and the buy/sell/hold signal point different ways.
reason.no_edge_over_baseline: On past data, this model was not more accurate for {{ticker}} than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.
reason.sentiment_unavailable: News could not be updated for more than a day, so this forecast uses prices only.

prediction.signalHelp: From a Random Forest classifier. Buy means it expects a rise of more than 1% tomorrow, sell a fall of more than 1%, hold anything in between.
prediction.notCoveredTitle: No forecast for this stock yet
prediction.notCovered: There is no forecast for {{ticker}} yet. Forecasts cover the {{stocks}} liquid KSE-100 stocks the model was trained and tested on.
prediction.insufficientData: Insufficient data for a reliable prediction. This stock doesn't have enough trading history yet.
prediction.notReady: No forecast yet. Forecasts are generated after each trading day's close.
prediction.evaluationTitle: How accurate has this model been for {{ticker}}?
prediction.evaluationDirection: From {{start}} to {{end}}, days the model never saw in training, it called the next day's direction right on {{direction}} of days. Always guessing "{{baselineDirection}}" would have been right on {{baseline}}.
prediction.evaluationErrorBeats: Its forecasts were typically off by {{error}} of the price, slightly better than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.
prediction.evaluationErrorNoEdge: Its forecasts were typically off by {{error}} of the price, no better than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.
prediction.evaluationSignal: The buy/sell/hold signal was right on {{accuracy}} of days, versus {{baseline}} for always giving the most common answer.
prediction.evaluationNote: Next-day stock moves are very hard to predict from past prices. These numbers are shown so you can judge the forecast yourself.

inputs.none: This forecast uses prices and technical indicators only. News sentiment is shown below for context.

sentiment.title: News sentiment
sentiment.subtitle: The tone of recent headlines about {{ticker}} in Profit and Mettis Global, scored by FinBERT, a language model trained on financial text.
sentiment.basis: Headlines counted: {{count}}, from the {{days}} trading days up to the close of {{date}}. Newer headlines count more; a headline's weight halves every {{halfLife}} trading days.
sentiment.noNews: No headlines about {{ticker}} from Profit or Mettis Global in the {{days}} trading days up to the close of {{date}}.
sentiment.note: Sentiment describes the tone of recent news, not where the price will go.
sentiment.probabilityNote: The percentage is how sure FinBERT is of each headline's label.
sentiment.scoredByVader: Scored by VADER because FinBERT was unsure
sentiment.afterCloseNote: These count from the next trading day.
sentiment.stale: News could not be updated for more than a day (last update {{date}}). The sentiment shown may be out of date.
sentiment.staleNever: News has not been collected yet, so there is no sentiment to show.
sentiment.notCoveredTitle: No news sentiment for this stock
sentiment.notCovered: News is collected for the {{stocks}} stocks that have forecasts. {{ticker}} is not one of them yet.
sentiment.loadError: We couldn't load the news sentiment.

portfolio.title: Your portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: A suggested way to spread your money across PSX companies, with every charge and tax shown.
portfolio.guidance: This is guidance, not a trade. InvestIQ places no orders. To act on it, use a licensed PSX broker.
portfolio.summary: Based on your {{category}} risk profile, here is a spread of {{cost}} across {{count}} companies.
portfolio.ratesAsOf: Charge and tax rates as of {{date}}
portfolio.unconfirmed: Rate not confirmed from an official source

idle.stock_cap: {{ticker}} already holds the most one company may hold in your portfolio.
idle.sector_cap: {{ticker}}'s sector already holds the most one sector may hold in your portfolio.
idle.flaggedSuggestion: To use it, include a company you left out or turn off the Shariah filter. Otherwise it stays as cash.
idle.small: {{amount}} is left over, less than the price of one more share of any company here.

notModelled.loss_set_off: Setting a loss off against other gains, or carrying it forward
notModelled.nccpl_cgt_charges: NCCPL's charges for working out capital gains tax
notModelled.trading_fee_sales_tax: Sales tax on the PSX trading fee

form.title: Build a portfolio
form.intro: Enter the amount you want to invest. Your risk profile ({{category}}) decides how widely it is spread.
form.capitalRequired: Enter the amount you want to invest.
form.capitalInvalid: Enter an amount in rupees, for example 100000.
form.filerHelp: Non-filers pay twice the tax on dividends.
form.shariahHelp: Shariah-compliant per PSX KMI review, effective 25 May 2026.
form.commissionHelp: Without your own rate we use the lowest commission PSX allows. Your broker may charge more. Enter your own rate.

empty.title: No portfolio yet
empty.body: Tell us how much you want to invest. InvestIQ will suggest how to spread it, with every charge and tax shown before you decide.

holding.breakEvenHelp: Selling at this price gives back everything you paid, charges included.
holding.exitTitle: If sold at the forecast price
holding.exitNote: This is a one-day forecast. Buying and selling costs about {{pct}} in total, so very short holds rarely pay.
holding.cgtNone: No capital gains tax: no gain at this price
holding.cgtNonFiler: Non-filer: NCCPL deducts 15%; individuals may owe more at normal income-tax rates.
holding.dividendsTitle: Dividends, if it pays what it paid in the last 12 months
holding.dividendsSource: Source: Yahoo; amounts not yet checked against PSX announcements.
holding.dividendsNone: No dividends recorded in the last 12 months.
holding.dividendsNote: Dividends from power producers and from companies that pay no tax can be taxed at other rates.
holding.whyRisk: Its price moved {{vol}} a day on average over the last year. Steadier prices get a larger share.
holding.whyForecast: The AI forecasts {{price}} for the next trading day ({{change}}).
holding.whyNoNews: No recent headlines about this company.
holding.whyTilt: The forecast and news changed its share by {{pp}} percentage points.
holding.whyNote: Shares mostly follow how steady each price has been. Forecasts can only adjust them a little, because no model has yet beaten a simple baseline.
holding.excludeConfirm: Leave {{ticker}} out and rebuild the portfolio?

lowCapital.title: This amount is too small for a {{category}} portfolio
lowCapital.body: {{capital}} is not enough for a {{category}} portfolio. To spread it across at least {{count}} companies with no more than {{pct}} in any one, you need about {{minimum}} at prices as of {{date}}. You can enter a larger amount.
lowCapital.noMinimum: {{capital}} is not enough for a {{category}} portfolio, and no amount up to Rs. 10,000,000 works with today's prices.

roll.title: Should anything be switched?
roll.intro: Each holding is compared with the other forecast stocks. A switch is suggested only when a holding has fallen well behind and the expected gain is larger than the cost of switching.
roll.benchmark: Benchmark: the average of the {{count}} forecast stocks since {{date}}, {{pct}}. The KSE-100 index is not available from our price source.

status.too_early: Too early to judge: {{days}} of {{required}} trading days so far.
status.not_triggered: Keep: {{relative}} against the benchmark, inside the {{threshold}} allowed for this stock.
status.no_replacement: It has fallen behind, but no other stock is forecast to do better.
status.costs_exceed_benefit: Switching to {{to}} would cost {{cost}} and is expected to gain only {{benefit}}. Not worth it.
status.suggested: Consider switching to {{to}}: expected gain {{benefit}}, cost of switching {{cost}}.

error.tooFewStocks: Too few companies are left after your choices. Include a company you left out or turn off the Shariah filter.
error.commission: The commission must be within the PSX range.
error.predictionsUnavailable: Today's forecasts are not ready yet, so a portfolio cannot be built. Please try again later.
error.archived: This portfolio has been replaced by a newer one. Reload the page.
error.notInPortfolio: That company is not in this portfolio.
error.load: Your portfolio could not be loaded.
